verdict.rationale: Jan's docs emphasize local-first storage, open-source code, and 'no vendor lock-in' when switching models, implying user data lives on-device rather than in a locked cloud silo, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'export data' feature or the specific open file formats (chat logs, settings, model configs) a user would take with them. missing for 10: explicit export/backup feature documentation, named open data formats (e.g., JSON/SQLite schema) for chats and settings, and any independent confirmation of a full data-export workflow.
